title: AAPS 2.8.2.9-dev, Yellow Warning Triangle in Main Screen
symptom: Since the update to AAPS 2.8.2.9-dev build 2b021ffaf, a yellow warning triangle appears in the top left corner of the main screen with no information about what it signals. AAPS runs without any problem.
cause: The triangle is intended to report BG data quality. Yellow means data must be recalculated to 5 min interval, red means there are BG duplicates preventing AAPS from running in closed loop mode.
fix: No fix is stated; the triangle is intended and indicates BG data quality. Yellow means data must be recalculated to 5 min interval, red means there are BG duplicates preventing closed loop.
evidence_quote: That the triangle is intend. It shows the quality of your bg data, if it goes to red closed loop will stopped. Milos Syd there: > there is new icon in 3.0-beta to report BG data quality. it looks like this. Yellow means data must be recalculated to 5 min interval, red means there are BG duplicates preventing AAPS from running in closed loop mode.
